编号只负责选行。这64项来自字符自己的参数行，还没有读取前文。: The ID selects a row. These 64 values come from the character embedding; no prefix has been read yet.
先归一化，再投影Q/K/V、旋转Q/K、计算因果注意力，最后混合各头结果。: Normalize, project Q/K/V, rotate Q/K, compute causal attention, then mix the head outputs.
注意力分支的64项，与入口原向量逐坐标相加。: Add the 64 attention-branch values to the original input, coordinate by coordinate.
前馈分支先归一化，再做SwiGLU。分支结果加回刚得到的表示。: Normalize before SwiGLU, then add the branch result to the current representation.
接收第一块的结果，使用第二块自己的参数，再次读取允许的前文。: Take block 1 output and use block 2 parameters to read the permitted prefix again.
第二块入口的原表示，加上这一块的注意力结果。: Add this block attention result to the representation at the block 2 entrance.
前馈处理各位置的坐标，再通过残差相加。位置数和64维宽度保持。: Process each position with the FFN, then add the residual. Position count and width 64 stay the same.
每个位置独立计算均方根，除回尺度，再乘该坐标的可训练参数。: At each position, divide by its RMS scale and multiply by the trainable coordinate scales.
64项表示分别与79行权重做点积，才得到候选分数。Softmax在完整79项间计: Dot the 64-value representation with each of 79 weight rows. Softmax normalizes all 79 scores.
大字是这一项乘积，不是总分或概率。其余63项也要参与求和。: The large value is this one product, not the total score or probability. The other 63 products also enter the sum.
这里直接读取参数表。同一个字符在不同位置查得同一行；上下文尚未参与。: This reads the parameter table directly. The same character looks up the same row at every position; context is not involved yet.
大字是两项之和。保留原值的直路与注意力分支在这里合流。: The large value is the sum of two terms. The direct path and attention branch meet here.
前馈分支值由已保存的出口减去相加前值还原，末位会有浮点舍入差异。: The FFN branch is recovered by subtracting the pre-addition value from the saved output. Final digits may differ due to rounding.
该坐标的缩放参数 g: Scale parameter g for this coordinate
64项共享同一均方根分母，每项再乘自己的g。归一化不减均值。: All 64 entries share one RMS denominator, then each is multiplied by its own g. No mean is subtracted.
这是注意力分支经过合头与输出投影后的一个坐标，尚未与直路相加。下方可查看这一块的: This coordinate is after head merging and output projection, before residual addition. Inspect this block attention weights below.
